中文

问题修复
- 登记表更新不再要求对所在目录的写权限:中转文件改走 `mktemp` 并原地改写,方案 B(免 sudo 共享组)下登记表放 `/etc` 只读目录也能正常心跳/`down`(双用户实测)
- 远端端口占用探测改走 stdin 直传,去掉命令行引号转义

其他变更
- 多人文档明确:管理员须预建登记表与锁两个文件,且仅这两个文件带组写权限

English

Bug Fixes
- Registry updates no longer require write access to the registry's directory: updates stage through `mktemp` and rewrite the file in place, so the shared-direct setup works with `/etc/dsh-ports.tsv` in a root-only directory (verified with two users)
- The remote occupancy probe travels over stdin instead of being shell-quoted onto the command line

Chores
- Multi-user docs: the admin must pre-create both the registry and its lock file; only those two files carry the group-write bit
